# 8NTIC

> 8NTIC is Remco Vroom’s independent research home for the Quantum Intelligence Protocol (QIP), custom-model research, experiments and publications. Its theme is “Always exploring.”

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.8ntic.com/): Overview of the research, projects and publications.
- [QIP](https://www.8ntic.com/qip): Quantum Intelligence Protocol, the flagship research project exploring governed agent autonomy, persistent memory and learning across execution cycles.
- [Research](https://www.8ntic.com/research): Research questions, including custom models trained on business knowledge, language and decisions. This is research in progress.
- [Experiments](https://www.8ntic.com/experiments): Practical explorations in the 8NTIC Experiments program.
- [Publications](https://www.8ntic.com/publications): Essays and research publications by Remco Vroom.
- [About](https://www.8ntic.com/about): Researcher and purpose.

## Publications

- [The Token Gap](https://www.8ntic.com/publications/the-token-gap): An essay on AI throughput, human judgment and reasoning efficiency.
- [QIP thesis introduction](https://www.8ntic.com/publications/qip-thesis): Introduction and link to the original Quantum Intelligence Protocol thesis.
- [Original QIP thesis](https://rem8ntic.substack.com/p/quantum-intelligence-protocol): Original external publication on Substack.
- [Publications RSS feed](https://www.8ntic.com/feed.xml)

## Experimental destinations

- [Recorder](https://recorder.8ntic.com): Experimental application. Access conditions are determined by that application.
- [QIP Adapter](https://qipadapter.8ntic.com): Experimental application with restricted access.

## Participation

- [Beta notifications](https://www.8ntic.com/beta): Register interest in future beta communications. Registration does not promise immediate product access.
- [Privacy](https://www.8ntic.com/privacy): Information about how notification signup data is handled.
- [Sitemap](https://www.8ntic.com/sitemap.xml)

The linked pages are the source of truth. Research hypotheses and experimental status should not be interpreted as verified product capabilities or certification claims.
